svg.title: Doorstep: system architecture
svg.text: A modular monolith on Render: one web service, one worker, one Postgres. AI proposes; only app/policy can refund, and every money write goes through the outbox.
People and AI clients · signed links, no logins
Postgres 16 · the one source of truth
Render web service · stateless, so it scales by adding copies
Every state change writes its audit row in the same transaction; a row lock serializes changes to one order.
Request from a person or an AI client
calls a model through the adapter
